solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Light source about Aldebaran that dances

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

indicators.note: letters that dance move around into a new order, so the star's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: An astronomer's lamp seems to whirl around a bright star in Taurus.
explanation.walkthrough: Aldebaran is a real star, so 'Light source' looks like it describes it; 'that dances' instead shuffles its letters, after C for circa.
explanation.definitionFit: A candelabra is a branched holder for several candles, which give light.

clue.text: Chap twice given a forage crop

indicators.note: the clue asks for the chap to appear two times over, one copy after the other

parts.note: Alf is a man's name, standing for any chap

explanation.surface: A farmer named Alf is handed a feed crop, perhaps two lots of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfalfa, also called lucerne, is a legume grown to feed livestock.

clue.text: Doctor round surgery to wilt from tiredness

parts.note: a round shape looks like the letter O
OP is short for operation, a piece of surgery

explanation.surface: A doctor on her rounds after surgery is drooping with fatigue.
explanation.definitionFit: To droop is to sag or flag, as a weary person or a thirsty plant does.

clue.text: Left road over lakes and isle in Welsh town

indicators.note: in a down entry the road sits over, that is above, what follows

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road
L abbreviates lake, doubled for the plural as pp does for pages
I is the map abbreviation for island or isle

explanation.surface: Directions: take the left road past some lakes and an island to reach a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lakes' gives LL, the plural of the abbreviation L.
explanation.definitionFit: Llanelli is a town in Carmarthenshire, south Wales.

clue.text: Greens right to interrupt EU talks?

parts.note: Brussels is the seat of the European Union, so stands for it

indicators.note: the letter breaks into the middle of the word for talks, splitting it

parts.note: spouts means talks at length

explanation.surface: A right-wing member heckles at a European Union summit about green issues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greens' looks political in the surface but means vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Brussels sprouts are small cabbage-like green vegetables, so they are greens on the plate.

clue.text: Some tyre tracks traced back in main road

indicators.note: traced back means the hidden letters are followed from the end to the start
some of the words means only part of their run of letters is used

explanation.surface: Tyre marks followed backwards along a major highway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes YRETRA from tyre tracks; 'traced back' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An artery is a major route for traffic, by analogy with a main blood vessel.

clue.text: Store needs time to fatten pig

indicators.note: putting a letter into the middle makes the word fatter, so it goes inside

parts.note: a sow is a female pig

explanation.surface: A shop needs time to fatten a pig for market.
explanation.definitionFit: To stow is to pack away or put in store.

clue.text: Broken-down Eurostar at last getting replacement

indicators.note: a broken-down train is in pieces, so these letters are rearranged
at last means the final letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: The Eurostar train breaks down, so finally a replacement service arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' gives G from getting, shuffled with EUROSTAR by 'Broken-down'.
explanation.definitionFit: A surrogate is a substitute, someone or something standing in for another.

clue.text: Good chap in love with tasty bird

indicators.note: the good chap is placed in amongst the letters that follow

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
rich food is tasty and full of flavour
ST is short for saint, a very good chap

explanation.surface: A decent man is fond of a delicious roast bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The ostrich is the largest living bird, a flightless runner from Africa.

clue.text: Administrator initially beaten for style

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of the word is used
beaten means knocked about, so the letters of the little word are scrambled

explanation.surface: A manager was first defeated on grounds of style.
explanation.definitionFit: An Afro is a hairstyle of tight curls worn in a rounded shape.

clue.text: Doctor given praise about theory regularly

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the praise goes round the other letters

parts.note: to adulate is to praise excessively

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A physician is flattered for a theory now and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' is not a physician but the verb, to tamper with; 'regularly' picks alternate letters of theory and 'about' wraps the praise round them.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor something is to tamper with it, much as one might taint or contaminate food.

clue.text: Intake ultimately failing to pass

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so the last letter of the word is taken

parts.note: a lapse is a failing or slip

explanation.surface: A student intake that finally fails to get through the exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Time is said to pass or go by; the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Conrad is dreadfully cynical

indicators.note: dreadfully suggests something badly done, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A judgement on the novelist Joseph Conrad as terribly jaded.
explanation.definitionFit: Sardonic means mocking and scornful, close to cynical in outlook.

clue.text: Meeting in such bars should be impossible

definitions.text: Meeting in such bars should be impossible

parts.words: Meeting in such bars should be impossible
parts.note: bars sounds like pubs where people meet, but the gymnastics apparatus has two rails running side by side which by definition never meet

explanation.surface: Some drinking spots are hopeless places for a rendezvous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bars' suggests pubs; it means the twin rails of gymnastics apparatus, and lines of this kind never meet.
explanation.definitionFit: Parallel lines run side by side at a constant distance and never converge.

clue.text: Jaguar car past bend an original model

indicators.note: past means beyond, so the car comes after the bend

parts.note: an arch is a curve or bend
the E-Type is a famous Jaguar sports car

explanation.surface: A sports car speeding round a corner is the prototype of its kind.
explanation.definitionFit: An archetype is the first pattern from which copies are made, a prototype.

clue.text: Long to see husband detained in unstoppable service

indicators.note: detained in means held inside, so the letter goes within the word

parts.note: an ace in tennis is a serve the opponent cannot return

explanation.surface: A tennis wife longs for her husband, kept busy serving aces.
explanation.definitionFit: To ache for something is to yearn or long for it.

clue.text: Dish three bears liked in time

definitions.meaning: in the Goldilocks fairy tale the three bears' bowls held oat breakfast
British slang for a prison sentence, as in doing time

explanation.surface: The fairy-tale bears' favourite breakfast served at the right moment.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is British slang for time in prison, also the title of a BBC sitcom set in a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Porridge is the oat dish in Goldilocks, and in slang a stretch inside.

clue.text: Circle in ground is complete

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the run of words

explanation.surface: A ring marked on the ground is now finished.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a flat round shape, a filled circle.

clue.text: Drive up motorway heading north to college

indicators.note: in a down entry heading north means read upwards, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI
LSE is the London School of Economics

explanation.surface: Instructions to drive up the M1 northwards to a university.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 motorway is written MI; 'heading north' reverses UPMI to IMPU.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive as a noun means an urge or impulse, an inner force pushing one to act.

clue.text: Careless attachment with men finally drawn into scheming

indicators.note: drawn into means pulled inside, so these letters go within the other word

parts.note: sly means cunning or scheming
love is a strong attachment

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A sloppy affair, with men eventually lured into intrigue.
explanation.definitionFit: Slovenly means untidy and slapdash, lacking care.

clue.text: Leading light left before British force

parts.note: ante is Latin for before
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A prominent figure who quit before joining the British armed forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading light' sounds like a prominent person, but means a lamp carried to lead the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A lantern is a portable lamp carried in front to show the way.

clue.text: Trouble with Ruby put on pedestal

parts.note: ado means fuss or trouble
ruby is a shade of red

explanation.surface: A woman called Ruby is idolised, which causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone on a pedestal is to idolise them, to worship and love them.

clue.text: Page in second book showing butter knife?

indicators.note: in means the page letter is placed inside the other letters

parts.note: a reader is a school book for learning to read

explanation.surface: A page within a second book that shows a picture of a butter knife.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by description: a butter knife is something that spreads.
explanation.definitionFit: A spreader is a blunt knife used to spread butter, so a butter knife fits it.

clue.text: American climber seen on river in valley

indicators.note: in an across entry, on means placed after, so the river comes first

parts.note: a vine is a climbing plant

explanation.surface: A US mountaineer spotted by a river in a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climber' suggests a mountaineer but is a climbing plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A ravine is a deep narrow gorge, a steep-sided valley.

clue.text: Food item with rocket served first

indicators.note: served first means the rocket comes before the other piece

parts.note: the V1 was a German wartime flying bomb, written VI
and means with, joining things

explanation.surface: A dish with rocket salad, put on the table first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocket' suggests the salad leaf, but is the V1 missile, written VI.
explanation.definitionFit: A viand is an archaic word for an article of food.

clue.text: Nuisance mentioned on every side in holiday region

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word is taken by how it is said

parts.note: a plague is a nuisance or pest
round means all around, on every side

explanation.surface: A pest is said to be everywhere in a tourist area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mentioned' gives PLAYG from how plague is said.
explanation.definitionFit: A playground can be a resort area popular for recreation, as in a playground of the rich.

clue.text: Response from congregation almost put right

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: to amend is to correct or put right

explanation.surface: Churchgoers' reply nearly corrects an error.
explanation.definitionFit: Amen is the word worshippers say together at the end of a prayer.

clue.text: Vincent for one displays good bearing

parts.note: ENE, east-north-east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: Vincent van Gogh, for instance, shows fine posture.
explanation.walkthrough: Vincent suggests van Gogh; it is Gene Vincent, the American rock'n'roll singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gene Vincent was the 1950s rocker behind Be-Bop-A-Lula, a first-name example.

clue.text: One to succeed bringing target into range

indicators.note: into means the target is placed inside the other word

parts.note: a descent is a downward slope, a range of falling ground
an end is an aim or target

explanation.surface: A shooter brings the target into range to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: A descendant is an heir, one who follows on after an ancestor.
